evidence.source: P1 A0 local accelerator on the same two A100 GPUs

invariants: Only task scheduling parallelism changes; model inference and simulator code are unchanged.
Every arm retains the preregistered six tasks, four evaluation seeds, 50 episodes per cell, and exact scene-seed manifest.
Every task is claimed atomically by one worker, so workers cannot duplicate or omit a cell.
Platform evaluation remains at one worker per GPU unless separately amended.
The unchanged verifier still requires exactly 24 cells and 1200 episodes before emitting a marker.
claim_limit: This amendment changes wall-clock evaluation scheduling only and provides no policy-effect evidence.
